notes.title: Play Scrap Galaxy online with Steam Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
Hello,

Jesper from Catalope Games here. Steam just added a new beta feature that allows you to play local multiplayer games online. It works via that the host streams the game to all clients and the clients send their input to the host. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/941c24ffec0c86195e9fba8f3faab8e1dd7e2ad9.gif[/img]

This means you can play Scrap Galaxy with anyone in your Steam friend list... Providing that you all have a quite good connection and are around in the same part of world.

More information can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]here [/url]about Remote Play Together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/9356fbe7212a1d4551c41e7ec5d55750a967c0f4.gif[/img]

[h1]How to play Scrap Galaxy with Remote Play Together?
[/h1]Remote Play Together is a beta feature that require to be on the beta channel of Steam updates.

The host start Scrap Galaxy and open up their friend list. Right click on a friend then pick the "Invite to Remote Play Together" option. The friend accepts then you are both playing Scrap Galaxy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/07f18551daf35f9d4772ff67628753660e2eb52a.gif[/img]

[h1]How to enable Steam beta?
[/h1]Go to your Steam settings. In the Account tab, opt-in for Beta participation. Steam will then restart and you should be ready. [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7021-eiah-8669]Here [/url]is a tutorial covering the subject.

Let me know how it works for you in the forums or join our little [url=https://discord.gg/KdJ6z7r]Discord[/url].
Jesper

notes.title: Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/17399099ce1225684b6f7801933899a81e57b8ab.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

Here are two patches (v1.0.7 and v1.0.6) that fixes some things requested by you the community. Firstly it adds a slider for how much the screen should shake when things are destroyed. Secondly it changes how sound is calculated, this makes the sound much more nice when there is a lot of bullets flying around.

[b]Scrap Galaxy v1.0.7[/b]
[list]
    [*]Add slider for screen shake amplitude.
    [*]Change how sound intensity is handled.
[/list] 

If you've encountered any more bugs please let me know in the forums!

Here is a small patch to fix some minor issues with the game. Mainly all co-op levels have been re balanced from Unity Analytic feedback.     [*]Fixed dialog box having wrong player color.
    [*]Added description to main menu.
    [*]Maybe fixed bug with round over and speed powerup.
[/list] 

If you've encountered any more bugs please let me know in the forums!

notes.title: Play Online with Parsec 🌟 Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/17399099ce1225684b6f7801933899a81e57b8ab.png[/img]

Hi! We have some really cool news to share with you. 

We have teamed up with Parsec to solve one of the most requested feature in Scrap Galaxy - Online multiplayer. Check the video below and go to [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]parsecgaming.com[/url] to learn more. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=420ZpQts3cY
Since you are in fact streaming the entire game to the other players it works better the closer you are to each other geographically. Let us know how it works for you in the forums.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/fae9cf88335b82d402a0e50c621630e304ed9ec4.png[/img]

Second update is that we have new art for the captains you play as. The designs are still very much the same, as we felt they matched the universe and tone quite well. But we now have a much more defined and polished style.

[b]Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.3[/b]
[list]
    [*]Add new art and portrait for characters.
    [*]Add --alwaysShowMouse parameter for MHOOK compability.
[/list]
